generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Clarify the strategy and standard used for this evaluation, collect benchmark results, claims, and reletive evidence

contract.purpose_user_function: Select an evaluation profile/standard and assemble claims, experiment/benchmark results, sources, evidence links, artifacts, and limitations.
contract.valid_inputs: Research artifacts, claims, evidence, benchmark/experiment results, required evidence profile/source types, review focus, and acceptance context.
contract.expected_outputs: An evaluation input set plus coverage/source/claim metrics and a review or closeout verdict.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes evaluation/review evidence and may move the workflow to pass, repair, hard-fail, or inconclusive state.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Returns failure/repair/inconclusive when artifacts are missing, schema-invalid, unreadable, or below configured evidence/coverage requirements.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Research evaluation assembly is implemented; generic benchmark-to-requirement assembly relies on external orchestration/IDs.
contract.success_evidence: `harness/lib/research/evaluator.py::evaluate_artifacts` accepts artifacts and calculates evidence/claim/citation/coverage/source metrics.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: Test evaluation profile, standard/threshold, claim set, benchmark/experiment result, evidence assembly, limitation inclusion, missing artifact, and incompatible artifact.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md#Appendix: AutoSci Commands (`/exp-eval`, `/review`, `/survey`); docs/integrations/autosci/full-parity-progress-report.md#Remaining Partial/Gated Routes documents incomplete global parity, provider-gated routes, and remaining semantic-proof gaps.
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Deterministic checks validate evidence structure and traceability, not real-world external validity; Review LLM or human judgment remains necessary for broader reasoning.
